dedupe_keys.name: data from spatio temporal graph neural network for urban spaces interpolating citywide traffic volume

description: The study authors publish graph-structured traffic data for Berlin cycling and Manhattan taxis. Zenodo supplies fourteen Parquet files free under CC BY 4.0. Berlin tables describe daily bicycle activity during 2019–2023; Manhattan tables cover hourly taxi-derived traffic for January–February 2016. Road geometries, five adjacency definitions and contextual weather, land-use, points-of-interest or socioeconomic features support spatiotemporal prediction. These inputs can benchmark demand-forecast components in transport simulations. Related catalogue data-strava-metro supplies upstream activity data, but does not explicitly cover these processed graphs. Coverage reflects selected platform users and taxi trips, not all travellers. Outlier filtering can remove real event peaks, and rounded precision or constructed adjacency affects model comparisons. Upstream source conditions require attention. No Parquet files were downloaded or prediction results reproduced.
